Hi Naomi / team / Elena,

Welcome — here's how we typically handle supplier setup and payment cadence at Redwood:

1) Default terms: Net 30 for new suppliers by default. We can make exceptions to Net 45/60 for negotiated enterprise agreements, but Net 30 is standard for vendor portal activation.

2) PO process: Yes — we require a PO for any invoice tied to a product/engagement. PO format: RDW-<4 digit project>-<YYMM> (e.g., RDW-2145-2803). If a supplier cannot include the PO on the invoice, they must put the PO number in the invoice remittance notes and email ap@redwood.com with the mapping.

3) Early-pay: We run an early-pay program via AP where suppliers can opt into dynamic discounts. Standard off-the-shelf offer: 1.0% if paid within 10 calendar days (Net 30 invoices only). For larger strategic partners we can evaluate 1.5% or a tiered program but that requires Procurement approval + enrollment in our vendor financing pilot.

Action items for ClearBridge to complete onboarding:
- Fill and return the Supplier Onboarding Form (attached).
- Upload W-9 and ACH authorization (or provide bank details via DocuSign).
- Confirm PO contact and preferred invoice destination (email + remittance notes).
- Indicate whether you want to enroll in Early-Pay (Standard: 1.0% / 10 days) or request an enhanced pilot offer (procurement will review).

Attachment: supplier_onboarding_form.xlsx (Excel)
Vendor portal: https://redwood-procurement.vendor-portal/clearbridge/onboard
DocuSign (ACH): https://dash.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-ONBOARD

Hi all,

Thanks for the attachments, Elena. From AP's perspective:

- We can accept Net 45 for the first two invoices if ClearBridge needs a runway, but standard onboarding will be Net 30 after setup. If you want Net 45 ongoing we need a signed SOW that lists Net 45 under payment terms and Procurement approval.

- Early-pay enrollment: we run the standard early-pay program at 1.0% / pay within 10 days. For the enhanced 1.5% request, Procurement must sign off and we need to schedule a 15-min credit/ops review (simple checklist: BCP, SOC2 in-scope, trade references).

- Documents needed to finish AP setup: completed onboarding form, ACH_authorization.pdf (signed), and PO remittance mapping (sample invoice with expected PO lines).

- Once enrolled, invoices should be emailed to invoices+clearbridge@redwood.com and include the PO number in the invoice header. AP will create a vendor record and generate the first PO within 3 business days of completed docs.

I'll start the vendor record once I have the onboarding form + ACH doc. If you'd like the early-pay pilot, reply to this thread and we'll add you to the procurement review queue.
